description: Fearless juniors, keen to lead smart progress is a team of passionate and aspiring first-year engineering students driven by curiosity,innovation, and teamwork. We believe that great ideas can create meaningful change, regardless of experience. Through NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to transform our vision into an interactive space exploration experience. With our project, AstroQuest – Mission Survival Simulator, we aspire to make space science engaging and dream beyond boundaries.
summary:
Astra Quest – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Astra Quest is an interactive web-based learning platform designed to introduce young learners to space exploration and the challenges of establishing human settlements on the Moon and Mars. We developed a mission-based experience featuring Moon and Mars quizzes, Mission Control for space-related questions, a Rocket Builder, a Rocket Launch Simulator, and an Outpost Command module where users explore resource management and survival-related decisions.

Our project addresses the challenge by transforming complex space exploration concepts into engaging, interactive learning experiences. Instead of simply reading about space missions, young learners can explore, experiment, answer questions, and understand the decisions involved in future space exploration.

Astra Quest aims to make space science more accessible, encourage curiosity and critical thinking, and inspire the next generation of space explorers, scientists, and innovators.
details:
Project Details – Astra Quest: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Astra Quest is an interactive, web-based educational platform that helps young learners explore the challenges of space exploration and future human missions to the Moon and Mars.

The platform works through different interactive modules. Users can test their knowledge through Moon and Mars quizzes with multiple levels, explore space-related questions through Mission Control, design rockets using the Rocket Builder, experience a visual rocket launch through the Rocket Launch Simulator, and manage resources and complete survival-related tasks in the Outpost Command module. The platform also includes a progress system with XP, ranks, badges, and browser-based progress saving to encourage continuous learning.

The main benefit is that it makes space science more engaging and understandable through hands-on digital activities rather than passive reading. Our intended impact is to develop curiosity, scientific thinking, problem-solving skills, and awareness of the challenges involved in future lunar and Martian exploration.

We developed the website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We used Visual Studio Code for development, GitHub for source-code management, and Vercel for deployment and public access.

The creative aspect of Astra Quest is its combination of space-themed learning, gamification, interactive simulations, and mission-based activities in a single platform. During development, we considered ease of use for young learners, simple navigation, engaging visual design, accessibility, and the educational value of each activity. Our goal is to make learning about future space missions enjoyable, interactive, and inspiring.
